llm.title: LLM backend
llm.help: Local llama.cpp automatically uses GGUF models in the model settings’ llm folder; no downloads. An external server URL is optional; OpenAI-compatible servers may take an API key (sent as Bearer token, also used by Prompt Forge).
llm.native: Available in the desktop app only.
llm.test.defaultPrompt: Say hello in one short sentence.
llm.openai.help: Official OpenAI Responses API. Prompts and selected reference images are sent to OpenAI only when you request drafting or analysis. API usage is billed separately. Uses low reasoning where supported; local sampling controls are ignored. No automatic retries.
